rows.mappingNote: New 留守番/るすばん article; house-sitting action and person.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive suru sense distinguished from the caretaker noun. Existing 留守 also has a genuine house-sitting sense; absence alone is not the whole family.

rows.mappingNote: New 例外/れいがい exception article.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/no behavior and 例外的 forms distinguished from an unrestricted na-adjective; specialness alone does not establish an exception.

rows.mappingNote: New 零点/れいてん article; zero marks, mathematical zero/root and zero Celsius.
rows.sourceNote: A mathematical zero is an input giving function value zero. Standalone noun distinguished from 零点 in decimal expressions such as 零点五. Temperature sense is Celsius, not all scales.

rows.mappingNote: New 冷凍/れいとう article; freezing/frozen preservation and transitive suru.
rows.sourceNote: 冷蔵 refrigerated storage and intransitive 凍る distinguished without denying ordinary refrigeration/chilling gloss overlap or inferring safe storage guidance.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary raincoat article.
rows.sourceNote: Search-only レーンコート and middle-dot variants not promoted to ordinary primary spellings. Rain protection differs from sports court and generic warming.

rows.mappingNote: New レクリエーション article explicitly recognizes source レクリェーション as a compatible recreation form.
rows.sourceNote: The source alias is attested in the complete pinned family. Re-creation sense2 is restricted to リクリエーション and is not transferred to the source spelling.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary leisure article; public definition additionally clarifies recreational use of free time.
rows.sourceNote: Free time and leisure activities overlap but are not every rest period, hobby, or relaxed manner. Public usage does not independently establish a JLPT assignment.

rows.mappingNote: New 列島/れっとう archipelago or chain-of-islands article.
rows.sourceNote: レツ+トウ becomes れっとう. Chain arrangement distinguished from one island and a peninsula; no rigid straight-line criterion or free renaming of geographical names.

rows.mappingNote: New level article; standard/rank, amount level, physical plane and leveling instrument.
rows.sourceNote: Separate rebel2861638 and Revell5094319 identities are not senses of supplied1145910. Actual ordinary rank/quantity/horizontal senses considered without making every specialized advanced grade synonymous.

rows.mappingNote: New 煉瓦/れんが brick article with usually-kana recognition.
rows.sourceNote: Kana-only レンガ is a written alternative, not a compatible metadata reading of the written pair. Both primary kanji retained despite absent component cards; existing 瓦 word is a different tile identity.

rows.mappingNote: New 連合/れんごう article; union/coalition, psychological association and abbreviated RENGO.
rows.sourceNote: Sense1 permits transitive/intransitive suru. Sense2 is field-specific, not casual socializing. Rare 聯合 stays secondary; organizational union does not require members to lose all identity.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary lens article.
rows.sourceNote: Pinned Dutch loan source has empty text; public Dutch lens supports explicit origin. Eye lens and optical lens distinguished from complete glasses, mirrors and material. Unrelated 練ず wrapper heading not transferred.

rows.mappingNote: New 蝋燭/ろうそく candle article with usually-kana alternatives.
rows.sourceNote: Kana-only ローソク/ロウソク and search-only 蠟燭 do not replace primary metadata. 燭ソク verified; candle object and emitted light are distinct without denying broader light-source uses.

rows.mappingNote: New ローマ字/ローマじ article explicitly recognizes the kana-final source form.
rows.sourceNote: 字 required in metadata despite empty source_kanji. Borrowed ローマ plus Japanese on 字 is an explicitly mixed formation, categorized with borrowed base as gairaigo; Roman letters are not inherently English.

rows.mappingNote: New 録音/ろくおん audio-recording article; transitive suru and recorded result.
rows.sourceNote: Resulting sound use grounded in public entry; action/result distinguished from recording devices, media and written minutes. 録る audio/video sense does not inherit 撮る's photographic restriction.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary locker/storage-cabinet article.
rows.sourceNote: Separate rocker identity2865131 not imported. 戸棚 family explicitly includes locker; open shelves and all storage spaces are not automatically synonyms.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary lobby/lounge article.
rows.sourceNote: Reception/waiting area and parliamentary anteroom recognized; physical doorway, corridor and all English political lobbying uses are not imported.

rows.mappingNote: New 論ずる/ろんずる article; discuss, argue and take into consideration.
rows.sourceNote: JMdict zuru alternative-of-jiru and traditional サ変 frameworks explicitly qualified. Productive examples use related 論じる conjugation, not invented godan forms; third sense is usually negative, not inherently passive.

rows.mappingNote: New 和英/わえい article; Japanese-English and abbreviated dictionary.
rows.sourceNote: Order marks lookup direction; 英和 opposite direction is not an interchangeable dictionary label. Dictionary abbreviation considered against full old 辞書/辞典/字引 bodies.

rows.sourceNote: Preserve original metadata, level, title, examples, grammar and exclusions. Source understood gloss is perspective, not passive morphology. Interjection sense3 is not added as a new independent N2 assignment.
